name: User Login
description: Email/password authentication with optional MFA verification and JWT token generation
mainFlow: User submits email and password
AuthService validates credentials against database
AuthService checks if MFA is enabled for user
If MFA enabled, send MFA challenge and wait for verification
AuthService generates access token and refresh token
Session record created in database
Tokens returned to user with expiration metadata

steps: Return 401 error with invalid credentials message
Prompt user to verify email via verification link

retryPaths: Retry token generation up to 3 times
Retry MFA verification up to 5 attempts

name: User Registration
description: New user registration with email verification, profile creation, and welcome flow
mainFlow: User submits registration form with email, username, and password
AuthService validates input data and checks for existing email/username
AuthService hashes password with bcrypt
User record created in users table
Profile record created in profiles table
Email verification token generated and stored
Verification email sent via Nodemailer
Welcome notification created
User returned with pending verification status
retryPaths: Retry email sending up to 3 times with exponential backoff

name: Content Upload Pipeline
description: Creator uploads content with watermarking, AI caption generation, and access tier assignment
preconditions: File meets size and type requirements
mainFlow: Creator selects file and metadata (title, description, tier, PPV price)
UploadService validates file type, size, and scans for malware
File uploaded to Cloudflare R2 temporary bucket
Content record created with 'processing' status
WatermarkService triggered via watermark queue for image/video content
AICaptionService triggered via caption queue for caption generation
Content status updated to 'published' after processing completes
Notification sent to subscribers about new content
retryPaths: Watermark queue retry 3 times with backoff

name: Subscription Purchase
description: Fan subscribes to a creator's tier with USDC payment via smart contract and access grant
preconditions: Fan does not have active subscription to this creator
Fan has connected wallet with sufficient USDC balance
mainFlow: Fan selects tier and initiates subscription
SubscriptionService creates pending subscription record
CryptoPaymentService generates subscription payment intent with USDC amount and smart contract address
Fan approves USDC spend and submits on-chain transaction via wallet
Smart contract verifies payment and emits Transfer event
CryptoPaymentService polls or listens for on-chain confirmation
SubscriptionService updates subscription status to active on confirmation
ContentAccess records created for all tier-appropriate content
Creator notified of new subscriber
Fan receives confirmation and content access granted

steps: Schedule first payment at trial end

retryPaths: Fan can retry payment from UI with new transaction

name: Tip Payment
description: Fan sends a USDC tip to a creator with optional message and fee calculation
preconditions: Fan has connected wallet with sufficient USDC balance
mainFlow: Fan selects tip amount and optional message
FeeService calculates platform fee and net creator amount
CryptoPaymentService generates tip payment intent with USDC amount and recipient addresses
Fan approves USDC spend and submits on-chain transaction via wallet
Smart contract transfers USDC, splits fee to platform and net to creator
CryptoPaymentService confirms on-chain transaction
Payment record created with fee breakdown and blockchainTxId
Creator notified of tip with message
Fan receives confirmation

steps: Check if referrer code was used

retryPaths: Fan can retry tip from UI with new transaction

name: Creator Payout
description: Scheduled USDC payout to creators for accumulated earnings with fee deduction
preconditions: Creator has registered wallet address on Base
mainFlow: System triggers payout batch processing at schedule interval
PayoutService calculates creator balance for the period
FeeService deducts platform fees from balance
Payout record created with 'pending' status
PayoutService initiates USDC transfer via smart contract to creator's wallet
Payout status updated on on-chain confirmation
Creator notified of payout completion
Payout history updated in creator dashboard

steps: System checks eligibility and minimum balance
Calculate reserve amount for potential refunds

name: Crypto Wallet Verification
description: Cryptographic verification of Solana wallet ownership via message signing
preconditions: User has a Solana wallet address
mainFlow: User adds wallet address to their account
CryptoService generates a unique verification message containing user ID and nonce
User signs the message with their Solana wallet private key
User submits the signature back to the platform
CryptoService recovers the public key from the signature
Recovered key compared with claimed wallet address
If match, wallet marked as verified
CryptoTransaction record created for verification event
retryPaths: Retry with alternative RPC endpoint up to 3 times

name: Real-Time Messaging
description: Fan sends a message to a creator with real-time delivery via Socket.IO
mainFlow: Fan sends message via Socket.IO or REST endpoint
MessageService validates message content and attachments
Message record created in database
Socket.IO server emits message event to recipient's connected clients
If recipient is offline, message delivered on next connection
Notification created for recipient
Read receipts tracked when message is viewed

steps: Message sent to all active subscribers

retryPaths: Message delivery retry up to 5 times

name: Content Moderation
description: Admin reviews reported content, takes moderation action, and resolves reports
mainFlow: User reports content or another user with reason and description
Report record created with 'open' status
Moderation queue updated with new report
AI moderation agent auto-screens content for violations
Admin reviews report details and auto-screening results
Admin takes action: warn, remove content, suspend user, or dismiss
If content removed, access revoked for all users
Report status updated to 'resolved' with resolution notes
Reporter notified of action taken
AdminAction record created for audit trail

steps: Flag content for manual review only

name: Referral Bonus
description: Referral bonus awarded when a new user signs up using a referral code and makes a purchase
preconditions: Referrer has generated a referral code
Referee used valid referral code at registration
mainFlow: Referee registers using referrer's referral code
Referral code validated and linked to referee account
Referee makes first qualifying purchase (subscription, tip, or PPV)
Payment processing triggers referral bonus calculation
ReferralService calculates bonus amount based on percentage of purchase
ReferralBonus record created with 'pending' status
Bonus amount added to referrer's bonus balance
Bonus becomes payable after refund period expires
Referrer notified about bonus award

steps: Reverse referral bonus if within refund period

name: Contest Lifecycle
description: Full contest lifecycle from creation through winner selection and prize distribution
preconditions: Creator has sufficient balance for prize (if applicable)
mainFlow: Creator creates contest with title, description, dates, prize, and entry fee
Contest status set to 'draft' for preview
Creator publishes contest, status changes to 'active'
Fans browse and submit entries before deadline
Entries approved by creator or auto-approved
Contest end date reached, status changes to 'judging'
Winner selected by vote count, creator decision, or random selection
ContestWinner record created with place and prize
Prize distributed to winner(s)
All participants notified of results
Contest status updated to 'completed'

steps: Contest cancelled with refunds if no minimum met

name: Enclave Application
description: Fan applies for exclusive enclave membership with review and approval process
mainFlow: Fan navigates to enclave page and reads about benefits
Fan submits enclave application with required information
Application record created with 'pending' status
Admin review queue updated with new application
Admin reviews application details
Admin approves or rejects application with notes
If approved, fan granted enclave membership and access
Notification sent to fan with result

steps: Fan may re-apply after cooldown period

name: Password Reset
description: User requests password reset via email link with token verification
preconditions: User has registered account with verified email
mainFlow: User requests password reset with email address
AuthService validates email exists in system
Reset token generated with 1-hour expiration
Password reset email sent via Nodemailer with token link
User clicks link and enters new password
AuthService validates token and expiration
Password hash updated in database
All active sessions invalidated except current
Confirmation sent to user email

steps: Do not reveal whether email exists
Allow user to request new reset link

name: Support Ticket Lifecycle
description: User submits support ticket, admin responds and resolves the issue
mainFlow: User submits support ticket with category, subject, and description
Ticket created with 'open' status
AI support agent auto-classifies and assigns priority
If auto-solution available, suggested response sent immediately
Ticket added to admin support queue
Admin reviews ticket and responds
User receives response notification
User confirms resolution or asks follow-up
Ticket marked 'resolved' when issue is closed
Satisfaction survey sent to user

name: Creator Broadcast
description: Creator sends broadcast message to all active subscribers via Socket.IO
preconditions: Creator has not exceeded broadcast rate limit
mainFlow: Creator composes broadcast message with optional media
MessageService validates broadcast content
Broadcast message recorded in database
List of active subscribers retrieved
Socket.IO emits broadcast event to all connected subscriber clients
Offline subscribers receive notification
Broadcast delivered to subscriber's message inbox as system message
Delivery metrics tracked for creator analytics

steps: Only subscribers of that tier receive broadcast
System triggers delivery at scheduled time

retryPaths: Undelivered messages queued for next subscriber connection

name: Verification Document Upload
description: Creator submits identity documents for verification with admin review
preconditions: Creator has not submitted same document type
Documents meet format and size requirements
mainFlow: Creator navigates to verification section in settings
Creator uploads identity document (ID, passport, or license)
Document encrypted and stored in protected R2 bucket
VerificationDoc record created with 'pending' status
Admin verification queue updated
Admin reviews document for authenticity and completeness
Admin approves or rejects verification with notes
If approved, creator marked as verified
Creator notified of verification result
Rejected submissions allow re-upload with correction guidance

steps: All documents must be approved for verification
